prerequisite: The single training-selected stable SAE feature must pass its prespecified validation association check. The negative raw-vector taxonomy comparison remains disclosed.
species_selection: Highest-activation labelled training species for the selected feature; scientific-name order breaks ties. The second-species replication, if reached, uses the highest-activation species from a different genus.
prompt: best quality, high quality, close-up profile photograph of the head of a single adult bird, seen directly from the side, closed beak, entire head and beak visible, sharp focus
prompt_scope: Names no species or beak elongation/size; taxonomy vector supplies species conditioning.

calibration.feasibility_gate: At least6of8 images have an eligible and measurable endpoint. Otherwise record failure and stop this image-trait branch.

measurement.review: One provisional AI screening pass using blind image IDs, separate from blank human scoring; no expert or independent-human claim.
measurement.eligibility: Single recognizable bird head, strict side profile, closed intact beak, complete tip and nasal opening visible, no substantial occlusion or glare over landmarks. Uncertain anatomy or view givesNA.
measurement.landmarks: Visible near-side nostril center, beak tip, upper beak surface at nostril level, lower beak surface at nostril level. All4 must be identifiable; do not infer hidden landmarks.
measurement.endpoint: ln(pixel distance nostril-to-tip / pixel distance upper-to-lower surface at nostril level). Treat as an image proxy for the published morphology, not a calibrated physical measurement.
measurement.uncertainty: Record image eligibility, coordinates, confidence notes andNA separately. Never substitute zero or infer an unseen nostril. Approximate pixel placements and projection remain limitations.
measurement.animal_focus: Use the bird-head region and landmark distances, not a whole-image embedding score. Retain original pixels with optional display-only overlays.

controlled_pilot.interpretation: A passing provisional screen warrants replication; it does not establish a causal biological trait. A failed screen is retained, without selecting another feature after looking at images.
